Priya / Sam — I pulled the invite render logs and traces for the tenant that Aerodyne hit. Short summary:
- The CSS manifest for our portal returned a 200 but one of the asset shards (bundle-v2-09.css) returned an empty body due to an S3 lifecycle transition for a cornered CDN origin. That resulted in the button element being present in DOM but styled display:none because of missing class rules.
- This affects a small subset of invites served between 08:50 and 09:20 PST; the service that retrieves shards failed to rehydrate the object.

Mitigation steps I pushed at 13:30 PST:
- Forced revalidation of the CDN object and invalidated the failing edge key. Should be propagated across edges now (~10 minutes).
- Created temporary direct invite URL that bypasses the standard page (tokenized ephemeral link) so Sam's team can accept while the CDN edge sync finishes. Link attached as temporary-invite-link.txt and also posted to INF-2198.

Work items: INF-2198 assigned to platform team to add a healthcheck on shard content length and alert on zero-length responses. I'll monitor traffic for the next 24 hours.

Sam — please try the direct link below after a hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) or in incognito. If still blocked, please attach the browser console output as requested by Priya.

Temporary invite link: https://app.redwood.com/onboard/invite/temporary/abc123 (also attached)

Ben Carter
